plans.idea: Keep the original's left-copy / right-product split: logo lockup tops a left text column (headline over subhead) while the bottle fills a tall right column, so it reads brand → headline → product left to right.
A centred vertical stack for the near-square format: logo centred at the top, full-width headline and subhead band, and a larger bottle centred below as the payoff, with no dead lower half.
Product-led mirror: a big bottle anchors the full-height left column while the right column carries headline and subhead, with the logo lockup closing the column at the bottom as a sign-off.
